privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected Maximum Root Flapwise Bending Moment (My) should be between 20,000 Nm and 60,000 Nm. For a 10m blade at 60 RPM and 25 m/s wind speed, the value is typically around 54,000-60,000 Nm. The airfoil must be NACA 0012 with 100 panels. The simulation must be a BEM sweep from 5-25 m/s.
